card.title: I Made the Exception
card.instruction: Treat every exception you once arranged as an unpaid obligation. Casually expect cooperation whenever the old favor becomes relevant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I got your late job application accepted. You can take my Saturday shift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you've had the job for all of them. Saturday seems modest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It took you one phone call.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then make one to the manager. Tell her you're covering Saturday; we'll call that even.
